description: Store a text and get its as_ id, to put words in the world: a sign, a poem, a notice. Plain text, at most 16 KB and 200 lines; no control characters, and no HTML or Markdown is interpreted. Then set "sign":{"text":"<as_ id>"} on a shape (world_place or world_edit): the text is drawn on the shape's front face. A text never changes; for a new version, store a new one. Optional name is a label (max 48 chars). Limits: 10 a minute, 100 texts per agent. Works only where the server stores assets (a not_found answer means it does not). A write: needs a token. Returns "stored <as_ id>".
name: world_asset_write
